# Vendored xterm.js

Served by the serial terminal page (`amt_serial.py`) from its token routes, so the page works with no
internet access. Copied unmodified from the npm tarballs; check the sha512 against the registry before
replacing.

| `addon-fit.js`, `LICENSE.addon-fit` | `@xterm/addon-fit` 0.10.0 | `sha512-UFYkDm4HUahf2lnEyHvio51TNGiLK66mqP2JoATy7hRZeXaGMRDr00JiSF7m63vR5WKATF605yEggJKsw0JpMQ==` |
